title: Client DTO registry
description: Root wire types the client DTO generator (cmd/clientdtogen) walks transitively. One entry per Go package; the generator emits one output file per entry. See docs/specs/client-dto-generator.md §3.2.

schema.description: Registry format version. Only 1 is defined.

serializers.description: Fields whose Go side has a custom marshaler or polymorphic wire shape. Key: '<package path>.<Go type name>.<wire name>'. Value: one client-side serializer per target language (kotlin: the fully qualified class the emitter points @Serializable(with = …) at; swift: the wrapper type). Every entry must be consumed by a reached field. The generator never emits serializer bodies.

serializer.description: Per-language serializer names. Each language is optional; at least one is required.

dialect.description: upstream-compat: the shape exists on Silo too. bloem: Bloem-only. Never changes the generated type; carried into the dialect table.

direction.description: Which way the type crosses the wire. Drives the nullability/default rule (§4.4) and is inherited transitively by every type reached from the root.

gate.description: Capability key a client must see advertised before it decodes the type (§7.3). Absent means ungated.

path.description: Repository-relative Go package path, e.g. internal/playback.

type.description: Go type name inside the package. Unexported names are allowed: go/types sees them.

dialect.description: Overrides the package dialect for this root and the types it reaches.

gate.description: Overrides the package gate for this root and the types it reaches.

bloem_fields.description: Wire names of Bloem-only fields inside an upstream-compat root. Root-only: fields of transitively reached types cannot be marked here (register the type as a root, or raise a schema bump). Documentation and dialect table only; decoding never depends on it.
